Aug 2018 • Friends
We was dining at hanoi food with big group. We ordered hanoi set menu 139.000 vnd for our dinner. The food totally good quality and very delicious. The price of this set menu compare with some restaurant in same concept is quite good price for travelers. We impressed with bun cha server in hot plate and desert in this menu. We will come back hanoi food if have opportunity visits hanoi again.

Really Good Tasted Special Grilled Fish
Jun 2018 • Friends
Really impressed by this dish.
Start with the perfect scent of banana leaf accompanying with fat fish when dish's served right after cook, smoke still spreading. 
Inside the leaf is golden fish which is careful medium cooked, fish is soft and covered by a little crunchy skin and well marinated. 
Highly recommend for those who look for an old quarter place and traditional Hanoian food cooked and decorated in a modern way. 
Cheers!

Interesting taste with grilled shrimp
Jun 2018 • Friends
I was in the middle of the old quarter and suddenly find out this restaurant. It's the saturday night and seem like the atmosphere was very hot and crowed. I chose some soft food for appetizers then choose the grilled shrimp with wine and grilled fish hanoi food style for the main courses. it's a big suprised with the taste of grilled, fresh shrimp, delicious sauces and well-displayed, the waitress is also nice and helpful. The price is reasonable and suitable for a mid-class person like me.
Highly recommend you guy to taste the grilled shimp with cognac wine here, especially for the first visit.
